title: mission-control-deploy-notes
content:
Purpose: quick, portable personal mission log for today's cutover. Keep minimal — run commands, reminders, and comms snippets. Not authoritative; canonical runbook is Confluence link above.

High-level goal:
- Promote 2026.03 release across hosted API and Dedicated pools with zero user-impact. Target window: 03/12 09:00-11:00 PT.

Pre-window sanity (T-120 to T-30)
- [ ] Verify dedicated pool health: dashboard -> dedicated/pool-alpha (SLOs green)
- [ ] Confirm scheduled autoscaler is disabled for pool-alpha during cutover (Aisha)
- [ ] Ensure canary is set to 5% traffic (Priya)
- [ ] Confirm fallback model variant exists (gptq-7b-fast) and is loaded on fallback nodes
- Quick checks:
  - kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving | grep pool-alpha | wc -l  # expect >= 8
  - curl -sS https://metrics.redwood.internal/api/pools/pool-alpha/health | jq .ready

Backports/patches we need to include:
- repo: serving-runtime
  - PR #842 (hotfix: kv-cache edge-case) -> must cherry-pick to release branch
    - cherry-pick commands to run: git fetch origin && git checkout release/2026.03 && git cherry-pick -x <commit>
    - target sideline branch name: backport/release-2026.03/kv-cache-fix
- repo: console (minor UI tolerated; non-blocking) -> no backport required

Deployment timeline (rough)
- 08:45 PT: final sync with SRE on pager coverage and incident lead
- 08:50 PT: open release channel #releases-release-2026 and ping stakeholders
- 09:00 PT: start automated rollout to canary nodes (5%)
- 09:10 PT: watch error-rate/latency for 10m
- 09:20 PT: increase to 25% if stable
- 09:35 PT: increase to 60%
- 09:50 PT: full switch to new model config across hosted pool (non-disruptive)
- 10:15 PT: start Dedicated pool migration in waves (pool-alpha, pool-beta)
- 10:45 PT: verify billing/tokens and metrics ingestion

Quick rollback triggers (if any true -> rollback):
- sustained error-rate > 0.5% for 15 minutes
- p95 latency > baseline + 1200ms for 10 minutes
- model quality regression flagged by QA eval endpoint (eval-run-2026-03-12)
- failed pods > 10% of pool size for 5 minutes

Rollback commands (emergency):
- revert rollout: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/rollouts/revert -d '{"release":"2026.03"}'  # ops token required
- scale-out fallback: k scale deployment fallback-model --replicas=6 -n redwood-serving
- emergency toggle-off autoscaler: POST https://infra.redwood.internal/api/autoscaler/disable?pool=pool-alpha

Comms snippets (Slack)
- Canary start: "Cutover note: starting canary rollout for release 2026.03 to hosted canary (5%). Monitoring latency and error rate. Ping @oncall-sre if you see anomalies."
- Rollback alert: "Rollback initiated for release 2026.03 due to elevated errors (details in #inc-2026-03-12). Eng lead: @Liam. SRE: please take page."

Open questions / TODO for after-cutover
- Confirm whether KV-cache metrics need higher retention (observability asks)
- Follow up PR to add automated evasive fallback when memory spikes (ticket RELENG-462)
- Coordinate with billing team to check token-metering discrepancies for dedicated customers

Notes-to-self (stream-of-consciousness)
- Keep an eye on slow-start logs in /var/log/serve/slow-start.log — last time there was a 403 that looked like auth token rotation issue
- If Graphite shows odd spikes at 09:12, correlate with autoscaler events (possible misread of queue-depth)
- Remember to run tiny sanity eval: python tools/eval_sample.py --host canary-1.redwood.internal --prompt 'hello'

Post-mortem anchors (if anything goes wrong)
- timeline: collect events from 08:30 -> 11:30 PT, export from chat logs and GitHub actions
- preserve canary snapshots: /mnt/backups/canary-snapshots/2026-03-12/*
- include links to PRs and Jira tickets in notes

Hand-off checklist (end of window)
- [ ] Confirm all canary alerts cleared
- [ ] Update runbook with any deviations and commands used
- [ ] Tag release notes with any breaking changes and backports included
- [ ] Send short summary to #releases and to product-ops (template below)

Summary template (for post-cutover message)
- Subject: Release 2026.03 cutover summary (hosted + dedicated)
- Body bullets: what changed, time window, issues observed (none / list), rollback? (no), follow-ups (links + owners)

-- end scratchpad --

(If this file looks messy: good. It's a working log. Copy anything important into Confluence + runbook later.)
